name: The Knife Revealed
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
The Stronghold's resident druid, Quintis Jonespyre, has some... unusual skills.  One of them involves psychometry - the ability to reveal an item's history by touch.  Don't ask me how he does it; I chalk it up to magic I do not and choose not to understand.  I do know, however, two things: one, I've seen it work and two, the bum owes me.

Take the knife up to Quint in his little tree-house here, and tell him for me that his Kalimdor Hold 'Em debt will be paid if he works his mojo on that knife.
narrative.objectives: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, adventurer.

While psychometry isn't an exact art by any stretch of the imagination, I've used it in times past to give insight into situations that others have chalked up to lost causes.  I think using it on the knife you've uncovered will give us a glimpse into what happened to Raschal.

It will only take a moment to do, but it isn't what I'd call a caster-friendly task.  Bear with me on this.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Ginro sent you, eh?

My psychometric readings are fairly draining on the psyche... but so are my losses at Kalimdor Hold 'Em.  They call me "King of the Bad Beats" here in the Stronghold.  Unlucky at cards... lucky at mastering the secrets of nature, I guess.

Anyway, of course I'll do it.  This may be just the breakthrough we need to uncover Raschal's fate.  If you would hand me the knife, we can get started.

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 43 to 46, 20,560 XP in all.

quests.name: The Missing Courier
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Missing Courier
quests.objectiveText: Locate the courier's boat somewhere along the coast of Feralas.

quests.name: Boat Wreckage
quests.objectiveText: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.

quests.name: The Knife Revealed
quests.objectiveText: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Psychometric Reading
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Woodpaw Gnolls
quests.objectiveText: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern Feralas for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.

quests.name: The Writhing Deep
quests.objectiveText: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep.

quests.name: Freed from the Hive
quests.objectiveText: Free Raschal from the Zukk'ash hive. Return to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.

quests.name: A Hero's Welcome
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Rise of the Silithid
quests.objectiveText: Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
